capitals.title: Capitals
capitals.notice: Contested capitals (Israel, Palestine, Yemen) and Nauru (no official capital) are left out.

countries.title: Countries
countries.notice: Covers the 193 UN member states plus the two observer states. Populations are World Bank estimates.

flags.title: Flags
flags.notice: Afghanistan’s flag is contested (two flags in use), so it appears on its learn card but not in flag questions.

jellyfish.title: Jellyfish & stingers
jellyfish.notice: Not for real-world identification. If stung, get first aid and follow local advice.

languages.title: Languages
languages.notice: "Main languages" are the official or most widely used languages of each country, simplified.

movie-moments.title: Movie Moments
movie-moments.notice: Original illustrations of famous film scenes, not real stills.

movies.title: Movies
movies.notice: Box office figures are worldwide grosses, not adjusted for inflation, as listed on Wikipedia in October 2026; they include re-releases where listed.

mushrooms.title: Mushrooms & fungi
mushrooms.notice: Never use this to forage. Many deadly mushrooms look like edible ones. Not for real-world identification.

quotes.title: Famous quotes
quotes.notice: Every quote is checked against Wikiquote. Famous misquotes appear as true-or-false questions.

words.title: Word origins
words.notice: Origins are checked against Wiktionary etymologies; many words passed through other languages on the way to English.

classical-piano.title: Classical on piano
classical-piano.notice: Played on a sampled grand piano from public-domain scores.

pd-melodies.title: Old songs & carols
pd-melodies.notice: Public-domain melodies played on a sampled piano.
